gen-flavors-gf-martian-mono: Stubby, playful, a bit bossy. Flavors towers over Martian Mono, a monospace body whose fixed-width letters sit far apart, so shrinking the heading would let the body take over.
gen-flavors-gf-matemasie: Flavors has towering lowercase that looks like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, and it dominates anything near it. Matemasie answers by spacing its plain sans letters broadly, giving the loud heading room to be loud.
gen-flavors-gf-menbere: Menbere reads tall and stacked, like rolled cord. Flavors, drawn at a single thickness, is the livelier partner, and that gap in character is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-flavors-gf-mitr: Contemporary and approachable, Mitr keeps its lowercase almost level with its capitals, which makes a dense, friendly texture under Flavors. Paragraphs would feel compact and steady.
gen-flavors-gf-momo-trust-display: Flavors looks like bent tubing, whimsical but firm in its diagonals. Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with drifting letters and a generous x-height, would carry a longer passage with plenty of breathing space.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta: Whimsical and loud, Flavors runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with towering lowercase. And Mukta, a sans-serif with tall-bodied small letters, quietly follows along underneath without competing.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-mahee: Flavors bends its s curves like wire and never thins them at the spine, which gives it a one-of-a-kind look. Mukta Mahee is the chunky, tall sans for sustained reading.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar is a sans with compressed ascenders, tidy and approachable beneath a shouting heading. Flavors supplies the swagger with one flat line weight throughout.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-vaani: Contemporary Mukta Vaani rides high at the waist, which gives it a lifted lowercase under Flavors, whose crossbars are as fat as its stems. The shared sturdiness is the pair's strength.
gen-flavors-gf-narnoor: Marker-nib swagger, no direction preference. Flavors draws loudly while Narnoor, a sans-serif with short ascenders over big bowls, would carry paragraphs in a settled, businesslike way.
